name: Yale Center for Engineering Innovation and Design
summary: Yale's Center for Engineering Innovation and Design, in the Becton Center: a design and fabrication space for Yale students, faculty and research staff.

sources.note: 'CT Makerspaces Map' attached to the superseded Google Site. This record is the 'Yale Center for Engineering Innovation and Design' pin and nothing else — the pin carried a name and a location, no other detail.

Own site: 15 Prospect Street, Becton Center 107, New Haven 06511; ceid@yale.edu. Membership page: 'Yale undergraduates, graduate and professional students, faculty, and research staff are all eligible'; members get '24/7, year-round swipe access' after a General Orientation.

gaps: whether anyone outside Yale can use it or attend events is not stated
capabilities: the site does not list equipment on the pages read
the coordinates are from the old Google Site map pin, not checked against the address
